title: Round 4 / ECDLP-10: Lean proofs of SLP coefficient bound (N3) and embedding-degree trace bound (B3)
question: Prove in Lean 4/Mathlib: (a) HYP-57d71f43 coefficient bound for addition/subtraction straight-line programs and its corollary; (b) HYP-eff2cfbb trace bound (or the strongest provable sub-statement), with exact statements and correspondence notes.
claims: Formal (Lean 4 + Mathlib, axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only): addition/subtraction straight-line program values are n*P with |n| <= 2^length (slpEval_mem_bound); if 2^(L+1)+1 < addOrderOf P some element of zmultiples P is unreachable by programs of length <= L (exists_unreachable_of_addOrderOf), in MathResearch/ECDLP/Barriers.lean.
Formal: #{t : t^2<=4q, M-bad} <= M(M+1) for q>=2, M>=1 (card_MBad_le), with sub-lemmas trace_unique_of_dvd and card_primes_lt; abstract arithmetic only, no curve connection or complexity claim.
next_action: PI: add `import MathResearch.ECDLP.Barriers` to MathResearch.lean, run full lake build, commit, independent review of definitions MBad/slpEval vs HYP statements.
notes: Adapter frontmatter model claude-sonnet-5-5; runtime identity not exposed to PI. Self-reported model identity: claude-sonnet-5-5 (Sonnet 5.5), runtime-stated; unverified externally. Barriers.lean uncommitted at time of run; HEAD 7c5d67114c1ebfe43ef8ee2bbce59c103ee67330.
